name: Double trading
summary: This EA implements a pairs trading / statistical arbitrage strategy by simultaneously opening opposite-direction positions on two correlated currency pairs when their correlation reaches a threshold. It monitors combined profit of both positions and closes them when the total profit target is hit, while also relying on StopLoss/TakeProfit as fallback exits. Auto mode determines trade direction based on session-specific currency strength assumptions.
summary_zh: 该EA实现了一种配对交易/统计套利策略，当两个相关货币对的相关系数达到阈值时，同时开立相反方向的仓位。它监控两个仓位的合计利润，达到目标利润后同时平仓，同时以止损/止盈作为兜底退出。自动模式根据交易时段的货币强度假设来确定交易方向。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念：该EA基于两个货币对之间的相关性进行统计套利，当相关系数接近设定阈值(-0.98±0.003)时开仓。入场条件：相关系数CorrelationBuffer[0]落入Open_Value±Demis_Value范围内，且当日为允许交易的星期、没有持仓时触发入场。自动模式下，根据GMT时段判断主流货币的强弱趋势来决定买卖方向（如欧洲时段EUR/CHF/GBP为强势货币），直接模式(default AutoD)两对货币开反向仓，镜像模式(AutoM)两对货币开同向仓。出场条件：双仓合计利润达到Profit参数(默认20)时同时反向平仓，或任一仓位触发止损/止盈后等待另一仓位也被止损/止盈。仓位管理：两对货币分别使用独立手数Lot1和Lot2，默认1和1.3，不设动态加仓或减仓逻辑。资金管理：无动态资金管理，固定手数交易，止损止盈均为5000点，属于较宽的止损设置。
strategy_analysis_en: Strategy concept: This EA performs statistical arbitrage based on the correlation between two currency pairs, opening positions when the correlation coefficient approaches a threshold (-0.98 ± 0.003). Entry conditions: triggered when CorrelationBuffer[0] falls within Open_Value ± Demis_Value range, the current day is an allowed trading day, and no positions are open. In auto mode, trade direction is determined by session-based currency strength assumptions (e.g., EUR/CHF/GBP are dominant during European session); in default mode (AutoD) the two pairs open opposite directions, while mirror mode (AutoM) opens same-direction positions. Exit conditions: both positions are closed simultaneously when combined profit reaches the Profit parameter (default 20), or when one position hits SL/TP, the EA waits for the other to also be stopped out or take profited. Position sizing: two independent lot sizes Lot1 and Lot2 (default 1 and 1.3), with no dynamic scaling logic. Money management: no dynamic money management; fixed lot trading with wide SL/TP of 5000 points each.

parameters.name: Lot1
parameters.description_en: Trading lot size for 1st currency pair

parameters.name: Lot2
parameters.description_en: Trading lot size for 2nd currency pair

parameters.name: Profit
parameters.description: 双仓合计目标利润(货币单位)
parameters.description_en: Target combined profit for both positions (in currency)

parameters.name: Auto
parameters.description: 自动交易模式: AutoD=反向(对冲), AutoM=镜像(同向)

parameters.name: AppliedPrice
parameters.description: 相关性计算所用价格类型

pros: 配对交易策略逻辑清晰，利用相关性进行统计套利，具有一定的理论基础
支持自动模式根据交易时段货币强度判断方向，增加了策略灵活性
设有双仓合计利润目标出场机制，有利于锁定套利收益
提供交易日过滤功能，可以避开不活跃或风险较高的交易日
pros_en: Clear pairs trading logic based on correlation with theoretical foundation for statistical arbitrage
Auto mode adds flexibility by determining trade direction based on session-specific currency strength
Combined profit target exit mechanism helps lock in arbitrage gains from paired positions
Trading day filter allows avoiding inactive or high-risk trading sessions
cons: 使用Sleep()函数阻塞OnTick线程，会导致EA无法响应其他事件，严重降低平台稳定性
止损/止盈后仅通过轮询历史交易记录判断是否另一仓位也被止损/止盈，存在死循环风险且逻辑脆弱
当任一仓位被SL/TP后，另一仓位可能长期浮亏无人管理，存在巨大风险敞口
相关性判断依赖外部自定义指标Correlation，若指标不存在则EA无法正常运行且无错误提示
代码编码问题导致俄语注释乱码，严重影响可读性和可维护性
使用StringLen()==3来判断Buy/Sell方向非常脆弱，依赖硬编码字符串长度而非内容比较
cons_en: Sleep() calls block the OnTick thread, preventing the EA from responding to other events and severely degrading platform stability
After SL/TP hit, polling history deals in an infinite loop to detect the other position's exit is fragile and risks infinite hangs
When one position hits SL/TP, the other may run with unlimited floating loss — a significant risk exposure gap
Correlation signal depends on an external custom indicator with no existence check or error handling if missing
Garbled encoding of Russian comments severely hurts readability and maintainability
Using StringLen()==3 to detect Buy vs Sell is extremely fragile, relying on hardcoded string length instead of content comparison
improvements: 移除Sleep()阻塞调用，改用状态机模式在OnTick中分步处理订单生命周期，避免阻塞主线程
增加单边仓位被止损/止盈后的另一仓位应急平仓逻辑，防止单边风险敞口无限扩大
使用PositionSelect或PositionGetTicket替代轮询历史记录的方式来管理持仓状态
将StringLen()==3的方向判断替换为字符串内容比较(如StringCompare)，提高代码健壮性
添加Correlation自定义指标的存在性检查，指标不可用时输出错误提示并禁止交易
improvements_en: Remove Sleep() blocking calls and replace with a state-machine approach in OnTick to handle order lifecycle without blocking the main thread
Add emergency close logic for the remaining position when one side hits SL/TP, preventing unlimited unilateral risk exposure
Replace history deal polling with PositionSelect/PositionGetTicket for proper position state management
Replace StringLen()==3 direction check with content-based comparison (e.g., StringCompare) for robustness
Add existence check for the Correlation custom indicator and disable trading with error message if missing

risk_points: Sleep()阻塞OnTick线程，可能导致平台卡死或无法及时处理其他事件
单边仓位止损后另一仓位缺乏保护机制，可能产生巨额浮亏
止损/止盈检测使用while(1)无限循环+Sleep轮询，存在死循环风险
默认止损5000点非常宽，单笔最大亏损可能极大
外部Correlation指标依赖无校验，指标加载失败可能导致错误信号
risk_points_en: Sleep() blocks OnTick thread, potentially freezing the platform and preventing timely event processing
No protection for the remaining position after one side hits SL/TP — unlimited floating loss possible
SL/TP detection uses while(1) infinite loop with Sleep polling, creating deadlock risk
Default 5000-point SL is extremely wide, allowing very large per-trade losses
No validation for external Correlation indicator — failed load may produce incorrect signals
